news.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit Kicks Off Academic Year
news.summary_en: On Tuesday, the Rockhurst University campus community came together for a Jesuit tradition — the Mass of the Holy Spirit.

news.title: Faculty, Staff Recognized for Service, Contributions
news.summary_en: As part of the All Companions Assembly on Aug. 19 that kicked off the academic year, Rockhurst University recognized several faculty and staff for both outstanding contributions and their years of service.
